info.title: Blueprint Integration Contract
info.description: Native backend external service boundary. One company per private Store; scoped dedicated integration credentials; durable records, pending commands, execution evidence and recoverable event replay. Independent from blueprint-agent/1 and the product version.

post.description: The credential is bound to this company Store and integration. Persist the token in the independent service secret store. The server stores its digest and does not return it on subsequent reads. No provider is connected or code executed.

post.summary: Append a source event or commit a versioned record revision
post.description: The event, new snapshot, history and idempotency receipt commit in the same transaction. Equal key/equal body returns the same receipt; equal key/different body conflicts. Updates require expected_version and strictly increasing source_revision. Only administrators write authoritative knowledge; external note/message synchronization never creates a send command.

get.summary: Resume the durable increment stream without deleting commands
get.description: Save delivered events and this cursor atomically in the external service before returning accepted. Never parse or synthesize cursors. The server checks the store, integration and immutable anchor; unknown/future/restore-diverged cursors return an explicit cursor_gap. Current scopes, originating user, expiry and record visibility are checked when delivering. V1 retains events; no webhook or browser poll is required.

200.description: Durably stored or current authorized representation.

post.summary: Append actual execution evidence for the original command ID
post.description: Each result is immutable and scoped to the original command and integration. Evidence cannot silently regress a terminal state. unknown remains unresolved and never authorizes blind resend. accepted proves local persistence only; completed, provider acceptance, delivery and read receipts are different evidence. Reconciliation from unknown to completed/failed/rejected requires nonempty payload.evidence.

get.summary: Read one explicitly granted native company reference
get.description: Only explicit resource_refs in current scopes are eligible; current server-side native resource permissions are checked again. This grants no general data API, search, export or attachment-download permission. Supported kinds are item (including uploaded documents) and report.

workspaceBasic.description: Existing workspace owner/admin identity; never provision it to the external service.

integrationBearer.description: Once-issued dedicated token. Only this API namespace, this Store and this integration; no general workspace API access.

deliverable.description: Dynamic read eligibility. Only pending commands with current actor/scope/expiry authorization are deliverable. False does not mean the action failed.
